base.now: I'm general manager of the Fox in Potton, a village pub with a team of 18. I'm known for being on the floor for every service and for keeping my staff.
base.achieved: I got wage cost down from 36 percent to 31 percent in a year by rebuilding the rota around when we were actually busy. I cut staff leavers to three in a year with a proper first week and a buddy for every new starter.
base.fixed: We had a wedding of 80 and the chef went off sick that morning. I got a chef from our sister pub, went on the pass myself and we got every course out. The couple left a five star review and booked their anniversary.
base.moving: The Fox is being sold. I want an independent pub where I can put my stamp on it and stay for years.
base.next: General manager of an independent pub with rooms, so I can learn the accommodation side.
base.care: Honesty. Owners hear bad news from me first. And I never talk down to staff.
base.best: Somewhere busy where I'm on the floor, with owners who are hands on and like straight talking.
base.real: I cook a lot, I'm at the gym a few mornings a week, and I help run the quiz at my local cricket club.

job.title: General manager
job.base: I run the whole pub, team of 18. Got wage cost from 36 to 31 percent in a year with a new rota. Brought in a proper first week for new starters and only lost three people the next year. Weekly P and L with the area manager, stock every Monday.
